subject: Do not copy stale 24-bit directory from MASTER snapshot
body:
Follow-up, not a stop:

1. ManifestHeader 132 vs 128 B still yours [§04.6].
2. Label ManifestHeader generation as pack_generation (32-bit) distinct from knowledge_generation (16-bit) used by Query/Result/NCG records, or unify them.
3. Transcribe live [§02.4] 32-bit directory into [§04]. Do not copy MASTER_CANON or nested R0.1 snapshot: those still show the rejected 24-bit T1 semantic_id.

Live authority: top-level numbered files on branch_agent_a / R1 CANON_BLUEPRINT copies A published.
